channel.title: Security on Apache Camel
channel.description: Recent content in Security on Apache Camel

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-59230
item.description: Camel-Mail: the MimeMultipart data format copied MIME headers onto the Camel message without a header filter strategy when unmarshalling with headersInline enabled, so a crafted message could inject Camel-internal headers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-60093
item.description: Camel-Azure-Storage-DataLake: the downloadToFile operation built the local download target from the remote path name without constraining it to the configured fileDir, so a name containing traversal segments could write outside that directory

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-63621
item.description: Camel-Knative: CloudEvent extension fields received in structured content mode were mapped onto message headers without applying any header filter strategy, so an untrusted sender could inject Camel-internal headers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-66906
item.description: Camel-Azure-Storage-Blob: the downloadBlobToFile operation built the local download target from the remote blob name without constraining it to the configured fileDir, so a name containing traversal segments could write outside that directory

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-66907
item.description: Camel-Google-Storage: the consumer appended the remote object name to the configured downloadFileName directory without constraining the result, so an object name containing traversal segments could write outside that directory

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-66908
item.description: Camel-platform-http-main: when JWT authentication was configured with a keystore but no issuer or audience, the iss and aud claims were never validated, so any unexpired token signed by a trusted key was accepted

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-71300
item.description: Camel-Atmosphere-Websocket: WebSocket dispatch header injection - the producer selected its target peers through Exchange headers whose names sat outside the filtered Camel namespace, so an external sender could take over the dispatch decision

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-78329
item.description: Camel-Undertow: the endpoint discarded the undertow-specific header filter strategy in favour of the base HTTP one, so the undertow filtering never ran on endpoint-configured routes

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-43866
item.description: Camel JMS deserialization filter bypass: a forged DefaultExchangeHolder carried in a JMS ObjectMessage passes the CVE-2026-40860 class check and is unmarshalled into the Exchange, letting an attacker who can publish an ObjectMessage inject the message body, headers, exchange properties, variables and exception

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-43867
item.description: Camel-PQC: The AWS Secrets Manager key-lifecycle manager deserializes persisted key metadata with java.io.ObjectInputStream and no ObjectInputFilter (same defect as CVE-2026-46590, reported independently)

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40047
item.description: Camel-Docling: Insufficient validation of custom CLI arguments enables argument injection and path traversal in DoclingProducer

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40859
item.description: Camel-Vertx-Http and Camel-Netty-Http: Unsafe Java deserialization of HTTP response bodies via a raw ObjectInputStream when transferException is enabled

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-43865
item.description: Camel-Hazelcast: Unsafe Java deserialization in default-configured managed Hazelcast instances enables remote code execution

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46453
item.description: Camel-Elasticsearch-Rest-Client: Exchange header constants without the Camel prefix bypass inbound HTTP header filtering, allowing untrusted clients to override the Elasticsearch query and operation

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46454
item.description: Camel-Cometd: Inbound Bayeux message headers are mapped into the Exchange without a HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing unauthenticated clients to inject Camel control headers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46455
item.description: Camel-Keycloak: The access-token validity window is not verified because the IS_ACTIVE check is missing from the TokenVerifier, allowing expired tokens to be accepted

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46456
item.description: Camel-AWS2-SQS: Inbound message attributes are mapped into the Exchange without an inbound HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing a message sender to inject Camel control headers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46457
item.description: Camel-NATS: Inbound NATS message headers are mapped into the Exchange without a configured HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing a client that can publish to the subject to inject Camel control headers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46584
item.description: Camel-Mail: The mail producer applied attacker-supplied mail.smtp.* / mail.smtps.* message headers as JavaMail session properties, allowing an attacker to weaken the SMTP transport security and, on releases before 4.19.0, redirect the connection and steal the configured SMTP credentials

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46585
item.description: Camel-Lucene: The query control headers used non-Camel-prefixed names (QUERY, RETURN_LUCENE_DOCS) that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to inject the full-text search query

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46587
item.description: Camel-Couchbase: Non-Camel-prefixed Exchange headers bypass HeaderFilterStrategy allowing operation override from untrusted input

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46588
item.description: Camel-CouchDB: Non-Camel-prefixed Exchange headers bypass HeaderFilterStrategy allowing operation override from untrusted input

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46590
item.description: Camel-PQC: The HashiCorp Vault and AWS Secrets Manager key-lifecycle managers deserialize persisted key metadata with java.io.ObjectInputStream and no ObjectInputFilter (incomplete remediation of CVE-2026-40048)

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46591
item.description: Camel-Neo4j: JSON property names from the CamelNeo4jMatchProperties header are interpolated into the Cypher WHERE clause without validation, allowing Cypher injection (incomplete remediation of CVE-2025-66169)

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46592
item.description: Camel-CXF: The SOAP operation-selection headers used non-Camel-prefixed names (operationName, operationNamespace) that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to redirect the invoked SOAP operation

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-46726
item.description: Camel-Vertx-Websocket: The inbound consumer maps externally-supplied WebSocket query and path parameters into the Exchange without a HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing injection of Camel control headers - enabling server-side request forgery and disclosure of secrets when bridged to an HTTP producer

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-48203
item.description: Camel-Solr: The SolrParam. and SolrField. Exchange header prefixes used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to inject Solr query parameters (server-side request forgery) and document fields

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-48204
item.description: Camel-MongoDB-GridFS: The gridfs.* control headers used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to switch the GridFS operation - including destructive file deletion - in the default configuration

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-48205
item.description: Camel-DNS: The dns.* and term Exchange header constants used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to redirect DNS queries to an attacker-controlled server (server-side request forgery) and enumerate internal hostnames

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-48206
item.description: Camel-JIRA: A set of non-Camel-prefixed Exchange header constants (IssueKey, ProjectKey, IssueTransitionId, …) bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to drive arbitrary JIRA issue operations using the endpoint’s configured credentials

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49042
item.description: Camel-Langchain4j-Tools: Tool argument headers are not filtered against declared parameters, allowing an LLM to inject arbitrary Exchange headers via tool call arguments

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49086
item.description: Camel-Dapr: The Dapr Pub/Sub consumer copied the inbound CloudEvent’s pub/sub-name and topic into producer-direction routing headers, allowing an actor who can publish to the subscribed topic to redirect the re-published message to an arbitrary Dapr Pub/Sub component and topic

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49097
item.description: Camel-IRC: The irc.sendTo (and other irc.*) Exchange header constants used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to redirect outgoing IRC messages to arbitrary channels or users

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49098
item.description: Camel-Kafka: The kafka.OVERRIDE_TOPIC (and other kafka.*) Exchange header constants used non-Camel-prefixed names that bypass the upstream HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to redirect Kafka messages to an arbitrary topic

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49099
item.description: Camel-Salesforce: Non-Camel-prefixed Exchange header constants (sObjectQuery, sObjectSearch, apexUrl, …) bypass the HTTP header filter, allowing an HTTP client to inject SOQL/SOSL queries, override the target SObject, and redirect Apex REST calls using the connected Salesforce user’s permissions

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-49365
item.description: Camel-Netty-HTTP: The muteException consumer option defaulted to false, so a processing error returned the full Java stack trace in the HTTP response body, disclosing sensitive internal information to unauthenticated clients

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-53913
item.description: Camel-Keycloak: KeycloakSecurityPolicy verifies the bearer access token only inside its role and permission checks, so in the default configuration (no required roles or permissions) the token is never verified and any non-null bearer value is accepted - a fail-open authentication bypass

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-55993
item.description: Camel-Atmosphere-Websocket: The inbound consumer maps externally-supplied WebSocket query parameters into the Exchange without a HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing injection of Camel control headers - enabling server-side request forgery and disclosure of secrets when bridged to an HTTP producer

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-55994
item.description: Camel-Iggy: The inbound consumer maps externally-supplied Iggy message user-headers into the Exchange without a HeaderFilterStrategy, allowing injection of Camel control headers - enabling server-side request forgery and disclosure of secrets when bridged to an HTTP producer

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-56139
item.description: Camel-Undertow: The muteException consumer option defaulted to false, so a processing error returned the full Java stack trace in the HTTP response body, disclosing sensitive internal information to unauthenticated clients - and the option was not honoured at all for Rest DSL consumers

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-56140
item.description: Camel-AWS2-SNS: An inbound Camel-namespace filter was added to Sns2HeaderFilterStrategy to align it with sibling components; because camel-aws2-sns is producer-only (no consumer) there is no reachable inbound header-injection path, so this is a defense-in-depth hardening change related to the camel-aws2-sqs issue CVE-2026-46456

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-45760
item.description: Camel K Cross-Namespace Build Deputy Attack

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-47323
item.description: Camel-CXF and Camel-Knative Message Header Injection via Missing Inbound Filtering

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-33453
item.description: Apache Camel: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes vulnerability in Camel-Coap component.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-42527
item.description: Permissive default ObjectInputFilter pattern admits java.net.** and enables DNS-based information disclosure

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-27172
item.description: Apache Camel: Unsafe Java deserialization in camel-consul ConsulRegistry allows arbitrary code execution via malicious values read from the Consul KV store

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-33454
item.description: Camel-Mail Message Header Injection via Improper Filtering

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40022
item.description: Camel-Platform-HTTP-Main: Authentication Bypass on Non-Root Context Paths in camel main runtime

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40048
item.description: Camel-PQC: Unsafe Deserialization from FileBasedKeyLifecycleManager

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40453
item.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2025-27636 in non-HTTP HeaderFilterStrategies (camel-jms, camel-sjms, camel-coap, camel-google-pubsub) allows case-variant header injection

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40473
item.description: Camel-Mina: Unsafe Deserialization in MinaConverter.toObjectInput() via TCP/UDP

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40858
item.description: Camel-Infinispan: Unsafe Deserialization in ProtoStream Remote Aggregation Repository

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-40860
item.description: Unsafe Deserialization of JMS ObjectMessage in camel-jms, camel-sjms, camel-sjms2 and camel-amqp

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-25747
item.description: Apache Camel: Camel-LevelDB: Unsafe Deserialization from LevelDBAggregationRepository

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2026-23552
item.description: Apache Camel: Camel-Keycloak: Cross-Realm Token Acceptance in KeycloakSecurityPolicy

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2025-66169
item.description: Cypher injection vulnerability in Camel-Neo4j component

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2025-30177
item.description: Camel-Undertow Message Header Injection via Improper Filtering

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2025-29891
item.description: Camel Message Header Injection through request parameters

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2025-27636
item.description: Camel Message Header Injection via Improper Filtering

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2024-22371
item.description: Exposure of sensitive data by by crafting a malicious EventFactory and providing a custom ExchangeCreatedEvent that exposes sensitive data

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2024-23114
item.description: Apache Camel: Camel-CassandraQL: Unsafe Deserialization from CassandraAggregationRepository

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2024-22369
item.description: Apache Camel: Camel-SQL: Unsafe Deserialization from JDBCAggregationRepository

item.description: Temporary File Local Information Disclosure in camel-jira

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2022-45046 (Retracted)
item.description: LDAP Injection in camel-ldap

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2020-11994
item.description: Server-Side Template Injection and arbitrary file disclosure on Camel templating components

item.description: Apache Camel JMX Rebind Flaw Vulnerability

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2020-11972

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2017-12633

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2017-12634

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2016-8749

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2017-5643

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2015-5348

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2015-5344
item.description: Apache Camel’s XStream usage is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution attacks.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2015-0264
item.description: The XPath handling in Apache Camel for invalid XML Strings or invalid XML GenericFile objects allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via an XML External Entity (XXE) declaration. The XML External Entity (XXE) will be resolved before the Exception is thrown.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2015-0263
item.description: The XML converter setup in Apache Camel allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via an SAXSource containing an XML External Entity (XXE) declaration.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2014-0002
item.description: The Apache Camel XSLT component will resolve entities in XML messages when transforming them using an xslt route.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2014-0003
item.description: The Apache Camel XSLT component allows XSL stylesheets to perform calls to external Java methods.

item.title: Apache Camel Security Advisory - CVE-2013-4330
item.description: Writing files using FILE or FTP components, can potentially be exploited by a malicious user.
